name: Example: 2027 DORA Security NFR Controls Testing Plan
description: The worked reference plan: Tier 1 and Tier 2 ICT assets, 2LoD CISO Office, approved by the ICT Risk Committee, with the 2027 quarterly cycle.

plan.title: 2027 Security NFR Controls Testing Plan — Tier 1 & Tier 2 ICT assets
plan.objective: By {period_end_long}, 100% of Security NFR data for Tier 1 and Tier 2 ICT assets is reviewed and attested by 1LoD asset owners, with 2LoD performing a data-quality review of every submission and evidence-based sample testing of Security NFRs each quarter, giving an independent annual conclusion that feeds the ICT risk management framework review.
plan.decisions_requested:
Approve the {year} Security NFR controls testing plan: its scope (Tier 1 and Tier 2 ICT assets), objective and quarterly operating cycle.
Approve the sampling methodology: attribute sampling at the stated confidence and tolerable deviation rate per tier, the coverage floors, risk-based top-ups and the deviation rule.
Endorse the resourcing and the escalation triggers, and mandate asset owners to attest by each wave deadline.

strata.name: Tier 1
strata.definition: ICT assets supporting a critical or important function

attributes.requirement: The asset is recorded in the ICT asset inventory with a named owner, a classification and the critical or important functions it supports.
attributes.procedure: Trace the asset from the inventory to its NFR record. Inspect the classification, the CIF mapping and their approval.
attributes.evidence_requested: Inventory extract for the asset; classification record with its approval.
attributes.pass_criteria: Inventory entry exists with a named owner; classification approved; CIF mapping agrees with the business impact analysis.

attributes.requirement: The asset's security requirements are specified and approved.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the asset's security requirements and the record of their approval.
attributes.evidence_requested: Security requirements or NFR sign-off for the asset.
attributes.pass_criteria: Requirements are documented and approved by the asset owner and the security function.

attributes.requirement: Users authenticate with unique identities, multi-factor authentication is enforced where the standard requires it, and authenticators are managed.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the authentication configuration and the account list for shared or generic identities.
attributes.pass_criteria: Unique identities only, or an approved exception; MFA enforced where required.

attributes.requirement: Access is granted on approval, recertified on the defined cycle, and removed for leavers.
attributes.procedure: Re-perform the latest access recertification on a sample of accounts and trace leavers to removal.
attributes.evidence_requested: User list; latest recertification record; leaver report for the period.
attributes.pass_criteria: Recertification completed within its cycle; no active leaver accounts; no access without approval.

attributes.requirement: Privileged accounts are minimised, individually approved and controlled.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the privileged account list against approvals and the privileged access management configuration.
attributes.evidence_requested: Privileged account list; approvals; PAM configuration or session records.
attributes.pass_criteria: Every privileged account is named and approved; privileged use is vaulted or logged.

attributes.requirement: Data at rest is encrypted with approved algorithms, and keys are managed in an approved key management service.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the storage encryption settings and the key management configuration.
attributes.evidence_requested: Encryption configuration; key management records (ownership, rotation).
attributes.pass_criteria: Encryption enabled with approved algorithms; keys held and rotated as the cryptography standard requires.

attributes.requirement: Data in transit is protected with approved protocols and cipher suites.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the interface configuration and a protocol scan of the asset's endpoints.
attributes.evidence_requested: TLS configuration; scan output for the endpoints.
attributes.pass_criteria: Only protocols and ciphers the cryptography standard allows.

attributes.requirement: Security events are logged and forwarded to security monitoring, and alerts are triaged.
attributes.procedure: Confirm the asset is onboarded as a log source; inspect a sample of its alerts and their triage.
attributes.evidence_requested: Log source onboarding record; alert sample with triage notes.
attributes.pass_criteria: Required events are logged and received; sampled alerts were triaged within the monitoring SLA.

attributes.requirement: The asset is scanned for vulnerabilities on the defined cadence and findings are remediated within the policy SLA.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the latest scan and the remediation records for open findings.
attributes.evidence_requested: Latest vulnerability scan report; remediation tickets.
attributes.pass_criteria: Scanned within the cadence; no finding open beyond its SLA without an approved exception.

attributes.requirement: The asset is configured to the approved hardening baseline, and deviations are approved.
attributes.procedure: Inspect a configuration compliance scan against the baseline and the approvals for deviations.
attributes.pass_criteria: No deviation from the baseline without an approval.

attributes.requirement: Network exposure is limited to what is approved, and internet-facing services sit behind the approved controls.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the firewall rules and an external exposure scan against the approved flows.
attributes.evidence_requested: Firewall rule set; exposure scan; approved network flows.
attributes.pass_criteria: No inbound exposure that is not approved.

attributes.requirement: The asset has been security tested within the last 12 months and the test's findings are tracked.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the latest security test report and trace its findings to remediation.
attributes.evidence_requested: Latest penetration test or equivalent report; findings tracker.
attributes.pass_criteria: A test completed within 12 months; every finding tracked to remediation or accepted.

attributes.requirement: Backups are taken and restores tested, and the RTO and RPO are defined and met in the latest test.
attributes.procedure: Inspect backup job results and the latest restore or recovery test against the RTO and RPO.
attributes.evidence_requested: Backup job report; latest restore test record.
attributes.pass_criteria: Backups succeed; a restore was tested within the testing cycle and met the RTO and RPO.

attributes.requirement: Changes to the asset are impact-assessed, approved and tested before release.
attributes.procedure: Select changes made in the period and trace each to its assessment, approval and testing.
attributes.evidence_requested: Change log for the period; the selected change records.
attributes.pass_criteria: Every selected change was assessed, approved and tested before release.

attributes.requirement: Components are vendor-supported or covered by an approved exception, and third-party services are under contract with security terms.
attributes.procedure: Inspect the component inventory's support dates and the third-party contracts' security clauses.
attributes.evidence_requested: Component inventory with support dates; contracts or service agreements.
attributes.pass_criteria: No unsupported component without an approved exception; contracts carry the security terms.

attributes.requirement: Every NFR the asset does not meet is covered by an approved, time-bound exception or a remediation plan.
attributes.procedure: Trace each NFR the asset does not meet to an exception or a plan of action.
attributes.evidence_requested: Exception register entries; plans of action and milestones.
attributes.pass_criteria: Each gap is covered by an approved, unexpired exception or tracked remediation.

steps.title: Confirm mandate, scope and independence
steps.deliverable: Mandate note signed by the CISO

steps.title: Extract the Tier 1/2 population from the ICT asset inventory and reconcile it to the CIF mapping
Confirm the Security NFR catalogue and test attributes
Sampling methodology, sizes and deviation rule
Agree 1LoD waves with asset owners
steps.deliverable: Wave schedule agreed with asset owners

steps.title: Coordinate with Internal Audit and Operational Risk
Plan approved by the ICT Risk Committee
Freeze the population; record the seed

steps.title: Mid-year plan review and recalibration
steps.deliverable: Recalibration note; change requests where needed

steps.title: Retests of remediated findings
steps.deliverable: Retest results recorded against the findings

steps.title: Year-end: 100% of Tier 1 & 2 reviewed
steps.deliverable: Every Tier 1 and Tier 2 asset attested

steps.title: Annual conclusion to the ICT Risk Committee / management body
Input to the annual ICT RMF review report
steps.deliverable: Section for the ICT risk management framework review report

steps.title: Weekly PM status & RAID
steps.deliverable: Weekly status note and RAID log

Plan change control (new, decommissioned or re-tiered assets)
1LoD wave review & attestation
steps.deliverable: Attested Security NFR data for the wave's assets

steps.title: 2LoD data-quality review of 100% of submissions
steps.deliverable: Data-quality review log, one entry per submission

steps.title: Sample selection
steps.deliverable: Frozen selection with its seed recorded

steps.title: Fieldwork
steps.deliverable: Completed test records, one result per attribute

steps.title: Findings agreed with owners
steps.deliverable: Findings raised with agreed owners and due dates

steps.title: Quarterly report
steps.deliverable: Quarterly progress report to the ICT Risk Committee

raci.activity: Approve the plan, scope and sampling methodology
Maintain the Tier 1/2 population and its CIF mapping
1LoD review and attestation of Security NFR data
Annual conclusion and input to the ICT RMF review

cadence.content: Progress against the quarter, blockers, RAID log
Wave progress, overdue attestations, evidence requests
KPI dashboard: coverage vs plan, tests, findings, utilisation
Quarterly progress report, deviations, plan changes for approval
Annual conclusion; input to the ICT risk management framework review

escalations.trigger: Coverage more than 10 points behind plan
Evidence more than 10 business days late
A Critical or High finding overdue, or an attribute concluded not effective

regulatory_basis.requirement: Assign the management and oversight of ICT risk to a control function with an appropriate level of independence, segregated from the first line and from internal audit.
regulatory_basis.how: The 2LoD CISO Office plans, tests and concludes; asset owners (1LoD) attest their own data; Internal Audit (3LoD) is informed and not part of the testing.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Identify, classify and document the ICT assets that support the business functions, and review the classification at least yearly.
regulatory_basis.how: Every Tier 1 and Tier 2 asset's Security NFR data is attested by its owner and data-quality reviewed by 2LoD within the year, in quarterly waves.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Identify all ICT assets, map those considered critical and their interdependencies, under an ICT asset management policy and procedure.
regulatory_basis.how: The scope population is extracted from the ICT asset inventory, reconciled to the critical or important function mapping, and frozen before the first draw.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Test the ICT systems and applications that support critical or important functions at least yearly.
regulatory_basis.how: Tier 1 assets support a critical or important function and are sample-tested against the Security NFRs every quarter. This complements the resilience testing programme; it does not replace it.

regulatory_basis.requirement: Review the ICT risk management framework at least yearly, and report on the review to the competent authority on request.
regulatory_basis.how: The annual conclusion goes to the ICT Risk Committee and the management body as an input to the framework review report.
